Name: MassMultiplayer
Author: Nanhlana
Description:
[size=5][b]MassMultiplayer[/b][/size]
[i]Host up to 99 players without building a single cabin.[/i]

[color=#ff6666][b]EXPERIMENTAL:[/b] Large player counts depend heavily on the host's CPU and network. 8-16 players is the recommended range. Back up your save before using this mod.[/color]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]1-99 players[/b] - The host sets the player limit in config.json or in Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM).[/*]
[*][b]No cabins needed[/b] - The mod keeps a few spare hidden cabins (placed off-map) so the game's farmhand slots never run out. You never have to build or see them.[/*]
[*][b]Farmhouse spawn[/b] - New players appear in the host's main farmhouse instead of a cabin.[/*]
[*][b]Starter seeds[/b] - Every new player receives 15 Parsnip Seeds once per character. If their inventory is full, the seeds drop near them.[/*]
[*][b]Shared bed[/b] - Several players can go to sleep in the same bed. The day ends when everyone is ready, as usual.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI 4.0+[/url][/*]
[*](Optional) Generic Mod Config Menu, for in-game settings[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Install the mod with Stardrop, or unzip it into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*][b]Every player must install this mod, including the host.[/b][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]MaxPlayers[/b] (default 8) - total players including the host, 1-99.[/*]
[*][b]SpareCabins[/b] (default 2) - empty hidden cabins kept ready for new players, 0-5.[/*]
[*][b]SpawnInFarmhouse[/b] (default true)[/*]
[*][b]GiveStarterSeeds[/b] (default true)[/*]
[*][b]SharedBed[/b] (default true)[/*]
[*][b]HiddenCabinOriginX / HiddenCabinOriginY[/b] - where hidden cabins are placed. Change only if you have map issues.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility and multiplayer[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The player limit and hidden cabins are handled by the host.[/*]
[*]Farmhouse spawn, starter seeds and the shared bed run on each player's own game, so they need the mod installed. Players without it can still join, but they spawn in their hidden cabin and get no seeds.[/*]
[*]If you join through a Steam invite, the lobby size may be fixed by Steam. Joining by IP, LAN or a virtual LAN (Hamachi, ZeroTier) avoids this.[/*]
[*]Mods that change cabins, farm buildings or sleeping may conflict.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Known limitations[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]At very high player counts, expect lag from world syncing. The host's hardware is the limit, not this mod.[/*]
[*]Hidden cabins exist in your save. Remove the mod only after backing up.[/*]
[*]The shared bed only takes over when someone else is already sleeping there; otherwise the vanilla behavior is used.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Back up your save first. Hidden cabins stay in the save file after the mod is removed.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Built with SMAPI and Harmony. Thanks to the SMAPI and GMCM authors.
